text: Theo’s relentless pursuit of the cosmos was driven by a deep-seated need to connect with his late mother, an astrophysicist who had taught him that the universe was a place of infinite wonder. He spent countless nights on the rooftop of his rural home, not just looking up, but searching for the specific patterns she had once pointed out. His actions were motivated by a desire to preserve her legacy, turning his stargazing into a ritual of remembrance. He often looked at the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, finding comfort in their soft, white forms that drifted lazily above the stars, reminding him that even the heaviest storms eventually pass, leaving the sky clear for the constellations he loved.
